about_short_description.short_description: Beauty Pie is a beauty buyers' club that gives members access to high-quality beauty products at transparent factory-cost prices.

product.name: Beauty Pie+ Membership
product.description: An annual membership that provides access to Beauty Pie’s member prices, savings on products, shipping offers, and other member benefits.

product.name: Skincare
product.description: A range of facial and body skincare products, including cleansers, serums, moisturizers, treatments, masks, SPF products, eye care, and skincare devices.

product.name: Makeup
product.description: A selection of complexion, eye, lip, and color cosmetics, together with makeup brushes, bags, accessories, and curated makeup kits.

product.name: Haircare
product.description: Hair cleansing, conditioning, styling, repair, heat protection, density, and treatment products for different hair needs.

product.name: Bodycare
product.description: Products for body cleansing, moisturizing, exfoliation, treatment, self-tanning, hand and foot care, aromatherapy, sleep routines, and shaving.

product.name: Fragrance & Lifestyle
product.description: Perfumes, candles, diffusers, and lifestyle products for personal fragrance and home scent use.
